answer_1.quote: We evaluate the descriptions LLMs generate for a concept... The evaluation of text generation is in general difficult. Moreover, in our scenario each concept have many different groundtruth examples in its description, thus existing automatic metrics such as BLEU and METEOR are not capable of accurately measuring the quality. Therefore, we rely on mainly human evaluation...
answer_1.outputs: Generated textual descriptions of physical concepts

answer_2.quote: We also propose an automatic metric via a self‑play game for this subtask... For each generated description of a concept, we mask the synonyms of the concept in it as in the previous selection subtask, and ask the same LLM to guess which phenomenon the definition refers to.

answer_3.quote: In the self‑play test, all LLMs can accurately recognize the physical concepts from the descriptions they wrote by themselves.

answer_4.quote: We ask the annotators to evaluate the quality of the generated descriptions. The evaluation uses binary scores: each description receives a score of 0 if it consists of any factual error on the concept itself or any unfaithful examples, and a score of 1 otherwise.
answer_4.guideline: Binary scoring of factual correctness (0 = error, 1 = no error).
